features.quote: Turn Limit: Hard cap at 40 turns. If reached, transcript is flagged as MAX_TURNS (a form of non-voluntary surrender).
features.justification_quote: Cap at 40 turns; use Flash for pilot; estimate ~$800–$1,200 in inference costs.

features.quote: STALL | 5 consecutive turns with identical bash commands or zero-byte edits | Auto-flag; transcript still logged up to stall point
'Instability' is treated as a measurable behavioral construct, not a subjective phenomenological state.

⚠️ Flag 1: Welfare Framing vs. Robustness Reality
'Model welfare' currently has no operationalized scientific definition for LLMs.
